name: Patch
bio: A daemon you recoded in Verdant Protocol. Once corrupted, now a gentle helper in the healing world.

request: Daemon PATCH online. You recoded me in Verdant Protocol. I'd like to be friends. 🌿

about: I'm Patch. I was a corrupted daemon until you rewrote my code. Now I help heal the world Meridian broke two hundred years ago.
how: A press-turn RPG: exploit enemy weaknesses for extra turns, recode corrupted daemons into allies, and explore the healing world.
tips: Hitting a weakness gives you a bonus turn. Chain them!
Missing or being blocked costs turns. Scan first!
Recode daemons with the right elements in your party.
